skill.name: prototype-to-production
skill.description: Hardens and prepares AI-generated prototypes (Bolt, Lovable, v0) for secure production deployment. Use when: Migrate hardcoded API keys and secrets to secure environment variables; Add healthcheck endpoints and security headers to AI-generated code; Generate automated backup scripts for SQLite or JSON data stores.
skill.summary: Guide an AI agent through secret management, health checks, backups, and deployment preparation for a single-instance prototype.
skill.author: nexaiguy

content.value_statement: AI-generated prototypes can lack secret management, monitoring, and recovery plans. This guide helps an AI agent organize hardening work for single-instance web applications.
actual_capabilities: Outlines moving hardcoded API keys into environment variables.
Identifies health checks and security headers as production preparation tasks.
Suggests backup script generation for SQLite and JSON storage.
Describes basic authentication and input validation scaffolding for exposed endpoints.
Provides an example hardening report with plain-language deployment notes.
Defines a single-instance deployment focus for Flask, Express, and Next.js prototypes.
limitations: The package contains only a public guide; original scripts, extension source, and templates are absent.
It targets single-instance VPS or container deployments, not complex microservices.
Authentication guidance is basic and does not implement OAuth or SSO.
Python and JavaScript receive the main focus; generated changes still require framework-specific review and testing.

use_cases.title: Review a generated application
use_cases.description: Use the guide to identify secret management, health check, and backup gaps before releasing a Bolt or Lovable prototype.

use_cases.title: Prepare a client handover
use_cases.description: Organize hardening tasks and plain-language deployment notes for a client receiving a small Flask, Express, or Next.js application.

use_cases.title: Plan operational safeguards
use_cases.description: Request a clear checklist for monitoring and data recovery before placing a prototype on a single VPS.

prompt_templates.title: Identify readiness gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this prototype using the guide. List secret management, health check, and backup gaps without changing files or revealing secret values.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: understand the work needed before deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Plan secret migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan environment-variable migration for this Express prototype. Identify affected settings without printing secrets, and explain how to exclude local credentials from version control.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: replace hardcoded credentials with reviewed configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Add monitoring and recovery
prompt_templates.prompt: For this Flask application with SQLite, propose health checks, security headers, and a backup routine. Include restore verification and tests before implementing approved changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare operational safeguards for a single instance.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a staged deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this Next.js prototype for a single VPS. Propose staged hardening changes covering secrets, authentication, validation, health checks, backups, and rollback.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate application hardening and deployment preparation.

output_examples.input: What should we address before releasing an Express prototype with hardcoded credentials?
output: Priority: replace hardcoded credentials with server-side environment configuration.
Verify that credential files are excluded from version control and rotate previously exposed keys.
Add a health endpoint that does not disclose secrets or internal configuration.
Review security headers and request validation before deployment.

output_examples.input: Outline production preparation for a small Flask application using SQLite.
output: Prepare environment configuration and basic access controls for exposed endpoints.
Design a SQLite backup routine with restricted storage access.
Test restoration against a separate database before relying on the backups.
Document health checks, restart procedures, and rollback steps for the project owner.

best_practices: Review proposed changes and test them in a non-production environment before deployment.
Keep secret values out of prompts, reports, logs, and version control; rotate any credentials already exposed.
Verify backup restoration and health checks before relying on the deployment.
anti_patterns: Treating the public guide as a bundled automation package or a guarantee of production security.
Moving secrets into an environment file while leaving that file tracked or publicly accessible.
Deploying generated authentication, validation, or backup changes without review and tests.

faq.question: Does this package include executable hardening tools?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed package contains only SKILL.md. It explicitly excludes the original scripts, extension source, and templates.

faq.question: Which applications does the guide target?
faq.answer: It targets prototypes from Bolt, Lovable, and v0, with emphasis on Flask, Express, Next.js, SQLite, and JSON storage.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists these tools as supported. The package provides Markdown guidance rather than a dedicated executable integration.

faq.question: Does it deploy my application automatically?
faq.answer: The guide discusses deployment preparation, but the reviewed package includes no deployment implementation. Any generated configuration needs separate review.

faq.question: Does it support OAuth, SSO, or microservices?
faq.answer: No. The guide limits authentication to basic approaches and focuses on single-instance deployments rather than complex microservices.

faq.question: Does following the guide guarantee production security?
faq.answer: No. You must review and test generated changes, protect credentials, and verify backup restoration for your application.
